description:
A fast SSH client for you and your AI agents, with a built-in MCP server.

Termalin is a cross-platform SSH client for Windows, macOS and Linux, with a tabbed terminal, an SFTP browser with a built-in editor, and end-to-end encrypted sync. It ships a built-in MCP server so AI agents can open SSH sessions through the app while you watch, with keys held by a custodian and never written to disk. The free tier is the full desktop app.
